data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 depends on SRC_005: algorithmic convergence on identical training data is a specific instance of the general leaderless-synchronization mechanism, where shared data replaces shared metrics as the coupling medium. The dependence is refuted if small services use locally generated, private training data that is not shared, breaking the convergence mechanism, or if the large service also uses a single shared training set for all its sub-services, eliminating its epistemic-firewall advantage.
